# Auto-Generated Health Log

> **This file is auto-generated by the `/health` Telegram command.**
> Run `/health` to refresh. Do not edit manually.

## How to Regenerate

When you type `/health` in Telegram, Legion:
1. Pings each API endpoint (MiniMax, Groq, Gemini, OpenRouter, Supabase, etc.)
2. Records status (✅ CONNECTED / ❌ ERROR + reason)
3. Overwrites this file with fresh results

## Manual Refresh
